name: youtube
tagline: Publish and Manage YouTube from QuoxCORE
description: Upload videos, manage metadata, organise playlists, and monitor your YouTube channel — all from Quox. Vault-integrated Google OAuth, channel dashboard, upload panel, and AI-assisted metadata.
shortDescription: YouTube channel management and video publishing.
author: QUOX
marketingPoints: Upload videos directly from Quox workflows or chat
Channel overview dashboard with key metrics
Agent chat for hands-free channel management

videoUpload.name: Video Upload
videoUpload.description: Upload MP4, MOV, and WebM videos with full metadata control. Resumable uploads handle large files and network interruptions.

metadataManagement.name: Metadata Management
metadataManagement.description: Edit titles, descriptions, tags, categories, and privacy status. AI-assisted suggestions for SEO-friendly metadata.

thumbnailUpload.name: Thumbnail Upload
thumbnailUpload.description: Set custom thumbnails on videos. Supports JPG and PNG up to 2MB at 1280x720.

playlistManagement.name: Playlist Management
playlistManagement.description: List channel playlists and add videos to them for organised content delivery.

channelOverview.name: Channel Overview
channelOverview.description: View subscriber count, total views, video count, and recent upload performance at a glance.

agentChat.name: YouTube Agent
agentChat.description: Chat with the YOUTUBE specialist agent to manage your channel hands-free.

analytics.name: Analytics Dashboard
analytics.description: View channel and video analytics: views, watch time, average duration, subscriber growth, daily trends.

comments.name: Comment Management
comments.description: Read, reply to, and moderate comments. Sentiment overview and inline reply drafting.

scheduling.name: Scheduled Publishing
scheduling.description: Schedule videos for future publication at a specific date and time.

seo.name: SEO Optimisation
seo.description: AI-assisted title, description, and tag suggestions following YouTube search best practices.

captions.name: Caption Upload
captions.description: Upload SRT or VTT subtitle files to videos for accessibility and search discoverability.

specialist.name: YOUTUBE
specialist.description: YouTube channel management and video publishing specialist
capabilities: Edit video metadata (title, description, tags, privacy)
Read, reply to, and moderate comments

requirements.external: YouTube channel with YouTube Data API v3 enabled via Google Cloud Console. Google OAuth credentials stored in Quox Vault.
